maddeler.e:
تلاشيت (form VI)
# تَلَاشَيْتُ (talāšaytu) /ta.laː.ʃaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاشَى (talāšā)
# تَلَاشَيْتَ (talāšayta) /ta.laː.ʃaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاشَى (talāšā)
# تَلَاشَيْتِ (talāšayti) /ta.laː.ʃaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاشَى (talāšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
